answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and audit-linked evidence: when k identities coordinate equivocation, their aggregate penalty grows as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, making concealment economically fragile. Even aliases named nectar, violet, or ocean cannot diversify correlated blame; asymmetric depreciation further erodes recovered stake.
